title: Nice but needs work
text: Nice but needs work. This is really comfortable on the bed. It gives a lot of added softness. It is made well. However, the reason I gave it 3 stars is because the sizing is wrong. It is definitely not a full size and it is not made for deep mattresses

product_metadata.title: Mattress Pad for Full Size Bed with 100% Ventilated Cotton Cover and Down Alternative Microfiber Filling with Secure Anchor Band Design Adapts to Mattress Depths from 6-22'', Machine Washable
